text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing, when I stopped by a 
sporting goods store, I unexpectedly ran 
into Sweep Tosho there, but—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... This dumbbell fits well in the 
hand. Hold this one too.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"I shall inspect the wrist weights as 
well. Wait there."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you! Pass me those clothes over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Also, get the one on top of that shelf 
too! You can reach it, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
What are you doing? Hold these weights, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez! The stuff on the shelf isn't done 
yet!

text_block_list.name: Orfe & Sweep
text_block_list.text:
—Make haste, cur. —Hey, hurry it up 
already!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking one order after another from 
Orfevre and Sweep Tosho... by the time the 
shopping was done, I was completely 
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're pretty good at helping out, aren't 
you♪ I was able to buy sooo much stuff!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You did such a fine job that I might just 
make you my familiar as a special treat♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then next is that cafe over there! Let's 
each order a different dessert and share 
them♪

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Nonsense.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
We're moving on to the next shop. Come 
along.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hold on a minute! They already decided to 
go to the cafe with ME!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Other than accompanying me on my shopping 
trips, this fellow has no important duties 
whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No way! I hate eating alone, no no no! If 
it's just shopping, go by yourself, Orfe!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What strange things to――...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A tense atmosphere hangs in the air. I 
have to find a way to smooth things 
over...!
choice_data_list: I'll ask if we can get it for takeout!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Indeed, I do feel quite thirsty.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —...Very well.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Mmm! This cake is so sweeeet♪

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Not bad.
choice_data_list:
(Thank goodness, they both seem to be in a 
good mood.)

(Thank goodness, they both seem to be in a 
good mood)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a break at a cafe with the two of 
them. Suddenly, a store clerk approaches 
Orfevre—

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
For our customer ordering tea, please 
enjoy this complimentary gift. It is a 
teaspoon shaped like a magic wand.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"No way!? It came with a bonus like 
that?!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...A magical teaspoon. Uuuuughhh...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...H-Hey, Orfe. Could you let me see that 
spoon for a sec? Here, let me check if 
there's any weird magic on it!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Take this tea set.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Wh-Why?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: It is not to my taste. Do as you please.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...! W-Well, if that's the case... I'll 
take it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Um... Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Takeout is fine and all, but where are 
we gonna eat it?
choice_data_list:
While you're shopping, I'll find a nice 
spot.

While you're shopping, I'll find a nice 
spot.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Hooh. Interesting. Then find us a spot 
with a good view."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That sounds wonderful! It'll probably 
taste much better that way, too!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
By royal decree. Satisfy Us with a 
magnificent view.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While accompanying Orfevre on her 
shopping, I used my phone and other tools 
to search for a spot with a great view. 
And what I found was—
choice_data_list: How about a spot like this terrace?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! This is pretty nice! The view is 
great, and the breeze feels amazing!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: How about you, Orfe?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Very well. I praise thee for discovering 
this place.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then! Let's dig in to our 
takeout right away!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, the three of them enjoyed tea 
time while taking in the scenery.
